rows.english: Known food options by month. Counted once per crop or product, not kilograms, portions or meals.
rows.zu: Izinketho zokudla ezaziwayo ngenyanga. Kubalwa kanye ngesitshalo noma ngomkhiqizo, hhayi amakhilogremu, izingxenye noma ukudla okudliwayo.
rows.st: Dikgetho tsa dijo tse tsejwang ka kgwedi. Di balwa hang ka sejalo kapa sehlahiswa, eseng dikhilograma, dikarolo kapa dijo tsa nako ya ho ja.
rows.ts: Swakudya leswi tivekaka hi n’hweti. Swi hlayiwa kan’we hi xibyariwa kumbe xikumiwa, ku nga ri tikhilogiramu, swiphemu kumbe swakudya swa nkarhi wo dya.
rows.ve: Zwiḽiwa zwi ḓivheaho nga ṅwedzi. Zwi vhalwa luthihi nga tshiliṅwa kana tshibveledzwa, hu si khilogiramu, zwipiḓa kana zwiḽiwa zwa tshifhinga tsha u ḽa.

rows.english: Repeat-year comparison, not a first-year harvest forecast. Preserved stock records use exact dates.
rows.zu: Ukuqhathanisa konyaka ophindayo, hhayi isibikezelo sesivuno sonyaka wokuqala. Amarekhodi okudla okugciniwe asebenzisa izinsuku eziqondile.
rows.st: Papiso ya selemo se iphetang, eseng ponelopele ya kotulo ya selemo sa pele. Direkoto tsa dijo tse bolokilweng di sebedisa matsatsi a tobileng.
rows.ts: Ku fananisa ka lembe leri phindhaka, ku nga ri mvhumbo wa ntshovelo wa lembe ro sungula. Tirhekhodo ta swakudya leswi hlayisiweke ti tirhisa masiku lama kongomeke.
rows.ve: Mbambedzo ya ṅwaha une wa dovholola, hu si mbonelaphanḓa ya khaṋo ya ṅwaha wa u thoma. Rekhodo dza zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho dzi shumisa maḓuvha o livhaho.

rows.english: No mapped bed or plot area is supplied, so used and free space cannot be shown.
rows.zu: Ayikho indawo yemibhede noma yezinsimu esebalazweni enikeziwe, ngakho indawo esetshenzisiwe nengasetshenzisiwe ayikwazi ukuboniswa.
rows.st: Ha ho sebaka sa dibethe kapa masimo a mmapeng se fanweng, kahoo sebaka se sebedisitsweng le se sa sebediswang se ke ke sa bontshwa.
rows.ts: A ku nyikiwanga ndhawu ya mibedo kumbe masimu ya le mepeni, kutani ndhawu leyi tirhisiweke ni leyi nga tirhisiwangiki a yi nge kombisiwi.
rows.ve: A hu na fhethu ha mibete kana masimu a re kha mapa ho ṋewaho, ngauralo fhethu ho shumiswaho na hu sa shumiswi a hu koni u sumbedzwa.

rows.english: The two food charts share a scale. A crop present fresh and kept still counts once; kept colours add other food kinds. Dated output records update fresh counts. Research season references and sources without local dates are outside food counts.
rows.zu: Amashadi amabili okudla asebenzisa isilinganiso esifanayo. Isitshalo esikhona sisisha futhi sigciniwe sibalwa kanye kuphela; imibala yokugciniwe yengeza ezinye izinhlobo zokudla. Amarekhodi okukhiqiza anezinsuku abuyekeza izibalo zokudla okusha. Izinkomba zocwaningo zezikhathi zonyaka nemithombo engenazo izinsuku zendawo azifakwa ezibalweni zokudla.
rows.st: Ditjhate tse pedi tsa dijo di sebedisa sekala se tshwanang. Sejalo se leng teng se le setjha mme se bolokilwe se ntse se balwa hang feela; mebala ya tse bolokilweng e eketsa mefuta e meng ya dijo. Direkoto tsa tlhahiso tse nang le matsatsi di ntlafatsa dipalo tsa dijo tse ntjha. Mehlodi ya dipatlisiso ya dinako tsa selemo le mehlodi e se nang matsatsi a sebaka ha e kenngwe dipalong tsa dijo.
rows.ts: Tichati timbirhi ta swakudya ti tirhisa xikalo xin’we. Xibyariwa lexi nga kona xi ri xo basa ni lexi hlayisiweke xi ha hlayiwa kan’we; mihlovo ya leswi hlayisiweke yi engetela mixaka yin’wana ya swakudya. Tirhekhodo ta vuhumelerisi leti nga ni masiku ti pfuxeta tinhlayo ta swakudya swo basa. Swikombo swa ndzavisiso swa tinguva ni swihlovo leswi nga riki na masiku ya ndhawu a swi katsiwi eka tinhlayo ta swakudya.
rows.ve: Tshati mbili dza zwiḽiwa dzi shumisa tshikalo tshithihi. Tshiliṅwa tshi re hone tshi tshiswa na tsho vhulungwaho tshi kha ḓi vhalwa luthihi; mivhala ya zwo vhulungwaho i engedza dziṅwe tshaka dza zwiḽiwa. Rekhodo dza mveledzo dzi re na maḓuvha dzi khwinisa mbalo dza zwiḽiwa zwiswa. Zwiko zwa ṱhoḓisiso zwa khalaṅwaha na zwiko zwi si na maḓuvha a henefho a zwi katelwi kha mbalo dza zwiḽiwa.

rows.english: Pantry storage requires each crop's source conditions. Preserved stock is shown only for recorded months; no amount, recipe or safe shelf life is inferred.
rows.zu: Ukugcina ukudla kudinga imibandela yomthombo yesitshalo ngasinye. Ukudla okulondoloziwe kuboniswa ezinyangeni ezirekhodiwe kuphela; akucatshangwa inani, indlela yokulungisa noma isikhathi sokugcina esiphephile.
rows.st: Poloko ya dijo e hloka maemo a mohlodi a sejalo ka seng. Dijo tse bolokilweng di bontshwa feela dikgweding tse rekotilweng; ha ho bongata, risepe kapa nako e bolokehileng ya poloko e hakanyetswang.
rows.ts: Vuhlayiselo bya swakudya byi lava swiyimo swa xihlovo swa xibyariwa xin’wana ni xin’wana. Swakudya leswi hlayisiweke swi kombisiwa eka tin’hweti leti rhekhodiweke ntsena; a ku ringanyetiwi nhlayo, ndlela yo lulamisa kumbe nkarhi lowu hlayisekeke wo hlayisa.
rows.ve: U vhulunga zwiḽiwa hu ṱoḓa nyimele dza tshiko dza tshiliṅwa tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe. Zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho zwi sumbedzwa kha miṅwedzi yo rekhodiwaho fhedzi; a hu anganyelwi tshivhalo, risipi kana tshifhinga tsho tsireledzeaho tsha u vhulunga.

rows.english: No preservation records supplied. Frozen, dried, fermented and processed food are not inferred from fresh harvest.
rows.zu: Awekho amarekhodi okulondoloza anikeziwe. Ukudla okuqandisiwe, okomisiwe, okuvutshelwe nokulungisiwe akucatshangwa kusukela esivunweni esisha.
rows.st: Ha ho direkoto tsa poloko tse fanweng. Dijo tse hoamisitsweng, tse omisitsweng, tsa ho bela (fermentation) le tse sebetsitsweng ha di hakanyetswe ho tswa kotulong e ntjha.
rows.ts: A ku nyikiwanga tirhekhodo ta vuhlayiselo. Swakudya leswi gwitsirisiweke, leswi omisiweke, swa mbiriso ni leswi lulamisiweke a swi ringanyetiwi ku suka eka ntshovelo wo basa.
rows.ve: A hu na rekhodo dza u vhulunga dzo ṋewaho. Zwiḽiwa zwo xwatuwaho, zwo omiswaho, zwa mbiliso na zwo shumiwaho a zwi anganyelwi u bva kha khaṋo ntswa.

rows.english: No preserved stock is recorded. This is a record status, not proof that the farm has no stock.
rows.zu: Akukho kudla okulondoloziwe okurekhodiwe. Lesi yisimo serekhodi, hhayi ubufakazi bokuthi ipulazi alinakho ukudla okugciniwe.
rows.st: Ha ho dijo tse bolokilweng tse rekotilweng. Sena ke boemo ba rekoto, eseng bopaki ba hore polasi ha e na dijo tse bolokilweng.
rows.ts: A ku rhekhodiwanga swakudya leswi hlayisiweke. Lexi i xiyimo xa rhekhodo, ku nga ri vumbhoni bya leswaku purasi a ri na swakudya leswi hlayisiweke.
rows.ve: A hu na zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho zwo rekhodiwaho. Itshi ndi tshiimo tsha rekhodo, hu si vhuṱanzi ha uri bulasi a ḽi na zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho.

rows.english: No kept-stock records are shown for the selected food categories.
rows.zu: Awekho amarekhodi okudla okugciniwe abonisiwe ezigabeni zokudla ezikhethiwe.
rows.st: Ha ho direkoto tsa dijo tse bolokilweng tse bontshitsweng dihlopheng tsa dijo tse kgethilweng.
rows.ts: A ku kombisiwanga tirhekhodo ta swakudya leswi hlayisiweke eka swiyenge swa swakudya leswi hlawuriweke.
rows.ve: A hu na rekhodo dza zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho dzo sumbedzwaho kha zwigwada zwa zwiḽiwa zwo nangwaho.

rows.zu: Izindlela zokulondoloza ezirekhodiwe: {methods}.
rows.st: Mekgwa ya poloko e rekotilweng: {methods}.
rows.ts: Tindlela ta vuhlayiselo leti rhekhodiweke: {methods}.
rows.ve: Nḓila dza u vhulunga dzo rekhodiwaho: {methods}.

rows.english: Space is for {area} m2 of mapped beds and plots only; trees, animal housing and ponds are outside this area. Numbers above space bars show used m2.
rows.zu: Indawo ingu-{area} m2 wemibhede nezinsimu ezisebalazweni kuphela; izihlahla, izindawo zezilwane namachibi kungaphandle kwale ndawo. Izibalo ezingaphezulu kwemigqa yendawo zibonisa ama-m2 asetshenzisiwe.
rows.st: Sebaka ke sa {area} m2 sa dibethe le masimo a mmapeng feela; difate, matlo a diphoofolo le matamo di ka ntle ho sebaka sena. Dipalo tse ka hodima dibara tsa sebaka di bontsha m2 tse sebedisitsweng.
rows.ts: Ndhawu i ya {area} m2 ya mibedo ni masimu ya le mepeni ntsena; mirhi, tindlu ta swifuwo ni mativa swi le handle ka ndhawu leyi. Tinhlayo leti nga ehenhla ka tibara ta ndhawu ti komba m2 leyi tirhisiweke.
rows.ve: Fhethu ndi ha {area} m2 ha mibete na masimu zwi re kha mapa fhedzi; miri, madzulo a zwifuwo na matavha zwi nnḓa ha afha fhethu. Mbalo dzi re nṱha ha mabara a fhethu dzi sumbedza m2 dzo shumiswaho.

rows.english: Some beds or plots have overlapping or invalid planting shares. Used space is capped at their mapped area; resolve the layout before relying on this comparison.
rows.zu: Eminye imibhede noma izinsimu inezingxenye zokutshala ezidlulanayo noma ezingavumelekile. Indawo esetshenzisiwe ikhawulwa endaweni esebalazweni; lungisa ukuhleleka ngaphambi kokuthembela kulokhu kuqhathanisa.
rows.st: Dibethe kapa masimo a mang a na le dikarolo tsa ho lema tse kopanang kapa tse sa nepahalang. Sebaka se sebedisitsweng se lekanyeditswe sebakeng sa tsona se mmapeng; lokisa moralo pele o tshepa papiso ena.
rows.ts: Mibedo kumbe masimu man’wana swi ni swiphemu swo byala leswi tlulanaka kumbe leswi nga riki swona. Ndhawu leyi tirhisiweke yi pimiwa eka ndhawu ya swona ya le mepeni; lulamisa dizayini u nga si titshega hi ku fananisa loku.
rows.ve: Miṅwe mibete kana masimu zwi na zwipiḓa zwa u ṱavha zwi pfukanaho kana zwi songo teaho. Fhethu ho shumiswaho hu pimiwa kha fhethu hazwo hu re kha mapa; lulamisani dizaini phanḓa ha u fulufhela uyu mbambedzo.

rows.ts: Mintiko ya vuhumelerisi ni tirhekhodo leti kayivelaka
rows.ve: Zwileme zwa mveledzo na rekhodo dzi siho

rows.english: Monthly records, crop-cycle benchmarks and food kept in stock are separate measures. Missing quantities are not zero.
rows.zu: Amarekhodi enyanga, izilinganiso zemijikelezo yezitshalo nokudla okugciniwe kuyizilinganiso ezihlukene. Amanani angekho awasho uziro.
rows.st: Direkoto tsa kgwedi, ditekanyo tsa medikoloho ya dijalo le dijo tse bolokilweng ke ditekanyo tse arohaneng. Bongata bo siyo ha bo bolele noto.
rows.ts: Tirhekhodo ta n’hweti, mimpimo ya mindzhendzheleko ya swibyariwa ni swakudya leswi hlayisiweke i mimpimo leyi hambaneke. Tinhlayo leti kayivelaka a hi ziro.
rows.ve: Rekhodo dza ṅwedzi, zwikalo zwa mutevhe ya zwiliṅwa na zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho ndi zwikalo zwo fhambanaho. Zwivhalo zwi siho a si zero.

rows.english: Monthly kg records
rows.zu: Amarekhodi ama-kg enyanga
rows.st: Direkoto tsa kg tsa kgwedi
rows.ts: Tirhekhodo ta kg ta n’hweti
rows.ve: Rekhodo dza kg dza ṅwedzi

rows.english: Green bars contain actual kg records only. Gold bars include expected kg. Actual replaces expected for the same food source and month. These are known subtotals; missing crop, tree and animal quantities stay outside them.
rows.zu: Imigqa eluhlaza iqukethe amarekhodi ama-kg angempela kuphela. Imigqa yegolide ihlanganisa ama-kg alindelwe. Okwangempela kungena esikhundleni sokulindelwe emthonjeni wokudla nasenyangeni efanayo. Lezi yizamba ezincane ezaziwayo; amanani angekho ezitshalo, izihlahla nezilwane awafakwa kuzo.
rows.st: Dibara tse tala di na le direkoto tsa kg tsa nnete feela. Dibara tsa kgauta di kenyelletsa kg tse lebelletsweng. Tsa nnete di nka sebaka sa tse lebelletsweng bakeng sa mohlodi wa dijo le kgwedi e tshwanang. Tsena ke dikakaretso tse nyane tse tsejwang; bongata bo siyo ba dijalo, difate le diphoofolo ha bo kenngwe ho tsona.
rows.ts: Tibara ta rihlaza ti na tirhekhodo ta kg ta xiviri ntsena. Tibara ta nsuku ti katsa kg leyi languteriweke. Ya xiviri yi siva leyi languteriweke eka xihlovo xa swakudya ni n’hweti yin’we. Leti i tinhlayo ta swiphemu leti tivekaka; tinhlayo leti kayivelaka ta swibyariwa, mirhi ni swifuwo a ti katsiwi eka tona.
rows.ve: Mabara madala a na rekhodo dza kg dza vhukuma fhedzi. Mabara a musuku a katela kg dzo lavhelelwaho. Dza vhukuma dzi dzhiela dzo lavhelelwaho vhudzulo kha tshiko tsha zwiḽiwa na ṅwedzi muthihi. Izwi ndi zwivhalo zwa zwipiḓa zwi ḓivheaho; zwivhalo zwi siho zwa zwiliṅwa, miri na zwifuwo a zwi katelwi khazwo.

rows.english: Monthly production kg are not recorded. The crop-cycle graph below is a planning benchmark; it does not fill in missing monthly harvest weights.
rows.zu: Ama-kg okukhiqiza enyanga awarekhodiwe. Ishadi lomjikelezo wesitshalo elingezansi liyisilinganiso sokuhlela; aligcwalisi izisindo zesivuno senyanga ezingekho.
rows.st: Kg tsa tlhahiso ya kgwedi ha di rekotwe. Tjhate ya potoloho ya sejalo e ka tlase ke tekanyo ya moralo; ha e tlatse boima ba kotulo ya kgwedi bo siyo.
rows.ts: Kg ta vuhumelerisi bya n’hweti a ti rhekhodiwanga. Chati ya ndzhendzheleko wa xibyariwa leyi nga ehansi i mpimo wo kunguhata; a yi tati mintiko ya ntshovelo wa n’hweti leyi kayivelaka.
rows.ve: Kg dza mveledzo ya ṅwedzi a dzo ngo rekhodiwa. Tshati ya mutevhe wa tshiliṅwa i re fhasi ndi tshikalo tsha u pulana; a i ḓadzi zwileme zwa khaṋo ya ṅwedzi zwi siho.

rows.english: Crop-cycle kg by first picking month
rows.zu: Ama-kg omjikelezo wesitshalo ngenyanga yokuqala yokuvuna
rows.st: Kg tsa potoloho ya sejalo ka kgwedi ya pele ya kotulo
rows.ts: Kg ta ndzhendzheleko wa xibyariwa hi n’hweti yo sungula yo tshovela
rows.ve: Kg dza mutevhe wa tshiliṅwa nga ṅwedzi wa u thoma wa u kaṋa

rows.english: full-cycle kg
rows.zu: ama-kg omjikelezo ogcwele
rows.st: kg tsa potoloho e felletseng
rows.ts: kg ta ndzhendzheleko lowu heleleke
rows.ve: kg dza mutevhe wo fhelelaho

rows.english: Each bar groups the entire crop-cycle benchmark by the month picking starts. It is not the weight harvested in that month. The source does not supply a monthly picking curve; quantities are not divided across a picking window.
rows.zu: Umugqa ngamunye uhlanganisa sonke isilinganiso somjikelezo wesitshalo ngenyanga okuqala ngayo ukuvuna. Akusona isisindo esivunwa kuleyo nyanga. Umthombo awunikezi ijika lokuvuna lenyanga; amanani awahlukaniswa kulo lonke isikhathi sokuvuna.
rows.st: Bara ka nngwe e bokella tekanyo yohle ya potoloho ya sejalo ka kgwedi eo kotulo e qalang ka yona. Ha se boima bo kotulwang kgweding eo. Mohlodi ha o fane ka tjhate ya phallo ya kotulo ka kgwedi; bongata ha bo arolwe nakong ya kotulo.
rows.ts: Bara yin’wana ni yin’wana yi hlanganisa mpimo wa ndzhendzheleko hinkwawo wa xibyariwa hi n’hweti leyi ku tshovela ku sungulaka ha yona. A hi ntiko lowu tshoveriwaka eka n’hweti yoleyo. Xihlovo a xi nyiki ndzandzelelano wa ku tshovela hi n’hweti; tinhlayo a ti aviwi eka nkarhi wo tshovela.
rows.ve: Bara iṅwe na iṅwe i kuvhanganya tshikalo tshoṱhe tsha mutevhe wa tshiliṅwa nga ṅwedzi une u kaṋa ha thoma ngawo. A si tshileme tshine tsha kaṋiwa kha uyo ṅwedzi. Tshiko a tshi ṋei tshati ya u kaṋa nga ṅwedzi; zwivhalo a zwi kovhelwi kha tshifhinga tsha u kaṋa.

rows.english: No crop-cycle kg comparison is available for cycles starting harvest in this dated year. Check planting dates, growing space and sourced crop benchmarks.
rows.zu: Akukho kuqhathaniswa kwama-kg omjikelezo wesitshalo emijikelezweni eqala ukuvunwa kulo nyaka onezinsuku. Hlola izinsuku zokutshala, indawo yokutshala nezilinganiso zezitshalo ezivela emithonjeni.
rows.st: Ha ho papiso ya kg tsa potoloho ya sejalo e fumanehang bakeng sa medikoloho e qalang kotulo selemong sena se nang le matsatsi. Hlahloba matsatsi a ho lema, sebaka sa temo le ditekanyo tsa dijalo tse tswang mehloding.
rows.ts: A ku na ku fananisa ka kg ta ndzhendzheleko wa xibyariwa ka mindzhendzheleko leyi sungulaka ku tshovela eka lembe leri ri nga ni masiku. Kambela masiku yo byala, ndhawu yo byala ni mimpimo ya swibyariwa leyi humaka eswihlobyeni.
rows.ve: A hu na mbambedzo ya kg dza mutevhe wa tshiliṅwa ya mutevhe ine ya thoma u kaṋa kha uno ṅwaha u re na maḓuvha. Sedzulusani maḓuvha a u ṱavha, fhethu ha u lima na zwikalo zwa zwiliṅwa zwi bvaho kha zwiko.

rows.ts: Tinhlayo ta swibyariwa leti nga ehandle ka nhlayo ya xiphemu xa ndzhendzheleko leyi tivekaka: {crops}.
rows.ve: Zwivhalo zwa zwiliṅwa zwi re nnḓa ha tshivhalo tsha tshipiḓa tsha mutevhe tshi ḓivheaho: {crops}.

rows.english: No monthly quantities are recorded for this dated year in kg, eggs, litres, items or kept-stock kg. Enter expected or actual amounts in the app; the printed monthly table appears once a quantity is recorded, including zero.
rows.zu: Awekho amanani enyanga arekhodiwe kulo nyaka onezinsuku ngama-kg, amaqanda, amalitha, izinto noma ama-kg okudla okugciniwe. Faka amanani alindelwe noma angempela ohlelweni; ithebula lenyanga eliphrintiwe livela lapho sekurekhodiwe inani, kuhlanganise noziro.
rows.st: Ha ho bongata ba kgwedi bo rekotilweng selemong sena se nang le matsatsi ka kg, mahe, dilitara, dintho kapa kg tsa dijo tse bolokilweng. Kenya bongata bo lebelletsweng kapa ba nnete ho app; tafole e hatisitsweng ya kgwedi e hlaha ha bongata bo se bo rekotilwe, ho kenyeletswa noto.
rows.ts: A ku rhekhodiwanga tinhlayo ta n’hweti eka lembe leri ri nga ni masiku hi kg, matandza, tilitara, swilo kumbe kg ta swakudya leswi hlayisiweke. Nghenisa tinhlayo leti languteriweke kumbe ta xiviri eka app; tafula ra n’hweti leri kandziyisiweke ri humelela loko ku rhekhodiwile nhlayo, ku katsa na ziro.
rows.ve: A hu na zwivhalo zwa ṅwedzi zwo rekhodiwaho kha uno ṅwaha u re na maḓuvha nga kg, makumba, ḽithara, zwithu kana kg dza zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho. Dzhenisani zwivhalo zwo lavhelelwaho kana zwa vhukuma kha app; thebuḽu yo gandiswaho ya ṅwedzi i bvelela musi tshivhalo tsho no rekhodiwa, hu tshi katelwa zero.

rows.english: ? means quantity not recorded, not zero. * marks a known stock subtotal with missing batch weights. Egg counts and litres use actual records where entered, otherwise expected records. They are never converted to kg. Stock kg are food already held; they are never added to new production.
rows.zu: ? kusho ukuthi inani alirekhodiwe, hhayi uziro. * imaka isamba esincane sokudla okugciniwe esaziwayo lapho izisindo zamanye amaqoqo zingekho. Izibalo zamaqanda namalitha zisebenzisa amarekhodi angempela lapho efakiwe, kungenjalo zisebenzisa alindelwe. Akuguqulwa kube ama-kg. Ama-kg okudla okugciniwe abonisa ukudla osekuvele kukhona; awangezwa ekukhiqizeni okusha.
rows.st: ? e bolela hore bongata ha bo rekotwe, eseng noto. * e tshwaya kakaretso e nyane e tsejwang ya dijo tse bolokilweng e nang le boima ba dihlopha bo siyo. Dipalo tsa mahe le dilitara di sebedisa direkoto tsa nnete moo di kentsweng, ho seng jwalo di sebedisa tse lebelletsweng. Ha di fetolelwe ho kg le ka mohla. Kg tsa dijo tse bolokilweng ke dijo tse seng di le teng; ha di eketswe tlhahisong e ntjha.
rows.ts: ? swi vula leswaku nhlayo a yi rhekhodiwanga, ku nga ri ziro. * yi fungha nhlayo ya xiphemu leyi tivekaka ya swakudya leswi hlayisiweke leyi kayivelaka mintiko ya swiphemu. Tinhlayo ta matandza ni tilitara ti tirhisa tirhekhodo ta xiviri laha ti nghenisiweke, loko swi nga ri tano ti tirhisa leti languteriweke. A ti hundzuluriwi ku va kg. Kg ta swakudya leswi hlayisiweke i swakudya leswi se swi nga kona; a ti engeteriwi eka vuhumelerisi byintshwa.
rows.ve: ? i amba uri tshivhalo a tsho ngo rekhodiwa, hu si zero. * i swaya tshivhalo tsha tshipiḓa tshi ḓivheaho tsha zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho tshi re na zwileme zwa zwigwada zwi siho. Mbalo dza makumba na ḽithara dzi shumisa rekhodo dza vhukuma he dza dzheniswa hone, arali zwi si zwenezwo dzi shumisa dzo lavhelelwaho. A dzi shandulwi u vha kg. Kg dza zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho ndi zwiḽiwa zwi re hone kale; a dzi engedzwi kha mveledzo ntswa.

rows.english: Tree kg by age are annual farm assumptions. They are shown in the future harvest pages and are not spread across monthly production bars.
rows.zu: Ama-kg ezihlahla ngokobudala ayizilinganiso ezicatshangiwe zepulazi zonyaka. Aboniswa emakhasini esivuno esizayo futhi awahlukaniswa emigqeni yokukhiqiza yenyanga.
rows.st: Kg tsa difate ka dilemo ke dikakanyo tsa polasi tsa selemo. Di bontshwa maqepheng a kotulo ya kamoso mme ha di arolwe dibareng tsa tlhahiso ya kgwedi.
rows.ts: Kg ta mirhi hi vukhale i mimpimo leyi ringanyetiweke ya purasi ya lembe. Ti kombisiwa eka matluka ya ntshovelo wa nkarhi lowu taka naswona a ti aviwi eka tibara ta vuhumelerisi bya n’hweti.
rows.ve: Kg dza miri nga miṅwaha ndi nyanganyelo dza bulasi dza ṅwaha. Dzi sumbedzwa kha masiaṱari a khaṋo ya tshifhinga tshi ḓaho nahone a dzi kovhelwi kha mabara a mveledzo ya ṅwedzi.
